get.description: State of fppd's single pending-insert slot as mirrored by the plugin: whether an inserted playlist announcement is pending or consumed, with a confidence qualifier evaluated at read time. Answers 404 on FPP builds whose plugin API has no playlistInserted callback (added in FPP 8.5), so a 404 honestly reports that pending-insert introspection is unavailable.

200.description: Route present; pending-insert introspection is available
